system.flavor:
Pull a friend clear of a collapsing scaffold, out of a spreading fire, off a bridge as it gives way, or out of the path of a stampede.

Not enough to move more than one person or carry anyone farther than a few steps.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including the target. Response (unopposed): Move it up to 2 units toward a visible empty supported space; recheck the area afterward.

surges.html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
Detect ordinarily concealed enemies within 2 units of the destination until the start of your next turn.
